# T-Mobile

> T-Mobile is a U.S. wireless and broadband provider offering 5G mobile plans, home internet, devices, prepaid service, and business connectivity.

T-Mobile’s website covers consumer and business wireless plans, smartphones and wearables, 5G network information, home internet offerings, prepaid service, support resources, and account management. It also includes specialized plans for seniors, military families, and first responders, plus device deals, trade-in options, and coverage tools.

## Wireless Plans

- [Cell Phone Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans): Compare T-Mobile unlimited phone plans, features, pricing, and included benefits.
- [Unlimited 55+ Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/unlimited-55-senior-discount-plans): Discounted unlimited plans designed for customers age 55 and older.
- [Military Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/military-discount-plans): Unlimited phone plans with discounts for military members, veterans, and families.
- [First Responder Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/first-responder-discounts): Discounted unlimited plans for first responders and their families.
- [Tablet Data Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/affordable-data-plans): Data plans for tablets, hotspots, and connected mobile devices.
- [International Passes](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/international-roaming-plans): Add-on options for international data, texting, and calling while traveling.

## Home Internet

- [Home Internet](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet): Overview of T-Mobile home internet service, availability, and key plan benefits.
- [Home Internet Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/plans): Compare home internet plan pricing, features, and equipment details.
- [Home Internet Availability](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/eligibility): Check whether T-Mobile home internet is available at your address.
- [T-Mobile Fiber](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/fiber): Learn about T-Mobile fiber internet service and supported locations.
- [Home Internet Support](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/home-internet): Troubleshooting, setup help, and account support for home internet customers.

## Phones, Tablets, and Devices

- [Cell Phones](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phones): Browse smartphones by brand, price, features, and current promotions.
- [5G Phones](https://www.t-mobile.com/5g/phones): Explore phones compatible with T-Mobile’s 5G network and plan options.
- [Tablets](https://www.t-mobile.com/tablets): Shop tablets and connected devices available through T-Mobile.
- [Smartwatches](https://www.t-mobile.com/smart-watches): Browse smartwatches, wearable plans, and device compatibility information.
- [Hotspots & More](https://www.t-mobile.com/devices/hotspots-and-more): Find mobile hotspots, trackers, and other connected devices.
- [Bring Your Own Device](https://www.t-mobile.com/resources/bring-your-own-phone): Check compatibility and bring your existing phone to T-Mobile.

## Deals and Upgrades

- [Phone Deals](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/deals-hub): Central hub for phone offers, switcher deals, and promotional discounts.
- [Trade-In Program](https://www.t-mobile.com/resources/phone-trade-in): Estimate device value and learn how T-Mobile trade-ins work.
- [Upgrade Your Phone](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-upgrade): Upgrade eligibility, financing options, and available device offers.
- [Switch to T-Mobile](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/switch-to-t-mobile-from-verizon-or-att): Offers and guidance for switching from another wireless carrier.
- [Keep & Switch](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/switch-to-t-mobile-from-verizon-or-att): Information on switching carriers while keeping your current phone.
- [Carrier Freedom](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/switch-to-t-mobile-from-verizon-or-att): Learn about switcher incentives and reimbursement-related offers.

## 5G Network and Coverage

- [5G Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/5g): Overview of T-Mobile’s 5G network, benefits, and supported experiences.
- [Coverage Map](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/coverage-map): Interactive map for checking T-Mobile wireless coverage by location.
- [Network Pass](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/free-trial): Try T-Mobile service on your phone before switching carriers.
- [T-Satellite](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/satellite-phone-service): Learn about satellite-based coverage for supported messaging and connectivity.
- [International Roaming](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/international-roaming-plans): Review roaming options, passes, and travel connectivity details.

## Prepaid

- [T-Mobile Prepaid](https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/home): Overview of prepaid wireless service, plans, and activation options.
- [Prepaid Plans](https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/prepaid-plans): Compare no-contract prepaid plans with data and calling features.
- [Prepaid Phones](https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/prepaid-phones): Shop phones available for use with T-Mobile prepaid service.
- [Prepaid Activate](https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/activate): Activate a prepaid SIM or device and start service.
- [Prepaid Refill](https://prepaid.t-mobile.com/direct-to-account): Refill a prepaid account or make a payment online.

## Business

- [T-Mobile for Business](https://www.t-mobile.com/business): Overview of wireless, internet, and enterprise solutions for businesses.
- [Business Wireless Plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/wireless-business-plans): Compare business phone plans, pricing, and line options.
- [Business Internet](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/solutions/business-internet-services): Internet connectivity solutions for small and large businesses.
- [Business Phones & Devices](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/devices): Browse phones, tablets, and hotspots for business customers.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/enterprise): Explore enterprise mobility, networking, and managed business services.
- [Government Solutions](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/industry-solutions/government): Connectivity solutions tailored for government organizations and agencies.

## Support and Account

- [Support](https://www.t-mobile.com/support): Main support hub for devices, billing, plans, and troubleshooting.
- [Account Hub](https://www.t-mobile.com/account): Access and manage your T-Mobile account online.
- [Billing Support](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/account/billing): Help with bills, payments, AutoPay, and account charges.
- [Device Unlock](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/devices/unlock-your-mobile-wireless-device): Requirements and steps for unlocking eligible T-Mobile devices.
- [SIM and eSIM Support](https://www.t-mobile.com/support/devices/sim-esim): Setup and troubleshooting for physical SIM and eSIM activation.
- [Contact & Stores](https://www.t-mobile.com/stores/locator): Find nearby T-Mobile stores and in-person support locations.

## Apps and Customer Programs

- [T-Life](https://www.t-mobile.com/apps/t-life): T-Mobile app experience for account management, shopping, and customer benefits.
- [T-Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/t-mobile-tuesdays): Weekly customer perks, discounts, and promotional offers.
- [Magenta Status](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/magenta-status): Customer benefits program with travel, dining, and entertainment perks.
- [Netflix on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/entertainment): Entertainment benefits included with eligible wireless plans.
- [Entertainment Benefits](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/entertainment): Streaming and entertainment perks available on qualifying plans.
